payload.text: UGS triggers in wadi mouths near MSR are higher-priority during low-light hours.
Hamrin range insurgent groups historically stage ambushes at terrain pinch points where covered approaches meet vehicular routes.

payload.salute: S: 1-2 dismounts; A: foot movement; L: UGS-A grid; U: unknown; T: 04:32Z; E: seismic+acoustic trip
payload.quote: Seismic signature consistent with single-file foot movement, ~2 persons.

payload.salute: S: 2 dismounts; A: foot movement W→S; L: UGS-B grid; U: unknown; T: 04:33Z; E: seismic trip
payload.quote: Bearing consistent with movement toward NAI-7 from high ground.

payload.salute: S: unknown; A: 3x burst transmission UHF 412 MHz; L: RF-1 grid; U: unknown; T: 04:34Z; E: encrypted handshake pattern
payload.quote: Burst pattern matches pre-staging comms profile from prior Hamrin incidents.

payload.salute: S: 3 dismounts w/ long arms; A: stationary in covered position; L: NAI-7 wadi mouth; U: civilian dress, no insignia; T: 04:36Z; E: positioned overlooking MSR PYTHON
payload.quote: Three figures with rifles in concealed position covering the road.

payload.summary: Likely ambush element forming at NAI-7
payload.reasoning: UGS-A and UGS-B trips with consistent bearing toward NAI-7, followed by RF burst comms matching pre-staging profile, then drone confirmation of three armed dismounts in covered position over MSR PYTHON. Pattern matches stored prior for Hamrin terrain pinch ambushes.

payload.salute: S: 1 vehicle; A: dust trail E along MSR PYTHON; L: VIL FORK; U: civilian pickup; T: 04:38Z; E: approaching NAI-7
payload.quote: Patrol reports civilian pickup heading east on MSR PYTHON, kicking up dust trail toward the wadi.

payload.summary: Ambush trigger imminent — vehicle approaching kill zone
payload.reasoning: Armed element confirmed at NAI-7; civilian-dress vehicle now approaching from VIL FORK along MSR PYTHON. Track convergence consistent with VBIED or trigger vehicle for static ambush.
